name: PostGIS 3.6 Spatial Database on Postgres 18
description: Drop-in Postgres with PostGIS for maps, geofencing and spatial queries.

POSTGRES_USER.description: Superuser created on first boot (Railway Postgres default).

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Superuser password, generated at deploy (32 letters, URL-safe). Changing it later needs ALTER USER as well.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Database created on first boot, with PostGIS, postgis_topology, fuzzystrmatch and pg_stat_statements enabled.

PGDATA.description: Data directory, a subfolder of the volume (required by Railway's Postgres wrapper).

PGHOST.description: Private hostname for other services (also used by Railway's Data tab).

PGPORT.description: Postgres port on the private network.

PGUSER.description: libpq user variable (Railway's Data tab and psql).

PGPASSWORD.description: libpq password variable (Railway's Data tab and psql).

PGDATABASE.description: libpq database variable (Railway's Data tab and psql).

DATABASE_URL.description: Private connection URL for services in this project (reference PostGIS.DATABASE_URL from your app's variables).

DATABASE_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public URL through the TCP proxy (QGIS, psql, apps outside Railway). TLS is offered; add ?sslmode=require for libpq clients. Empty host if the TCP proxy is removed.

SSL_CERT_DAYS.description: Validity of the self-signed TLS certificate; it is renewed automatically 30 days before expiry.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time Postgres gets for a clean shutdown on redeploy.

PG_TUNE.description: true: size shared_buffers, work_mem, parallel workers etc. from the container's memory/CPU limits at every boot. false: Postgres defaults.

PG_TUNE_MEMORY_MB.description: Optional memory budget in MiB for the tuning. Empty = the service memory limit, capped at 16384.

PG_TUNE_CPUS.description: Optional CPU count for parallel-query settings. Empty = the service CPU quota, capped at 8.

PG_REQUIRE_TLS.description: true: every non-local login must use TLS (pg_hba hostssl), including private-network apps. Keep false for drop-in compatibility.

POSTGIS_AUTO_UPDATE.description: Apply PostGIS patch updates (3.6.x) to existing databases after an image rebuild. Minor upgrades are never automatic.

POSTGIS_TIGER_GEOCODER.description: First boot only: also create the legacy US TIGER geocoder (removed in PostGIS 3.7).

PGUSER.description: Superuser used for pg_dump (reads every database and role).

PGDATABASE.description: Database used to list databases; also the default for restores.

BACKUP_S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3 endpoint of the Railway Bucket.

BACKUP_S3_BUCKET.description: S3 name of the Railway Bucket.

BACKUP_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Railway Buckets use virtual-hosted URLs; true only if the Bucket's Credentials tab says path-style.

BACKUP_PREFIX.description: Folder in the bucket; each run writes {prefix}/{YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ}/ plus {prefix}/LATEST.

BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Backups older than this are deleted after a fully successful run. 0 keeps everything.

BACKUP_DATABASES.description: Optional comma-separated databases to dump. Empty = every non-template database.

BACKUP_COMPRESSION.description: pg_dump --compress value (zstd:N, gzip:N, lz4 or none).

BACKUP_PING_URL.description: Optional URL requested after each successful run (e.g. a healthchecks.io check) to alert on missed backups.
